beats.event: Frodo inherits the Ring at Bilbo's birthday party
Gandalf reveals it is the One Ring; Frodo must flee the Shire
Sets out on foot with Sam and Pippin
Elrond forms the Fellowship of the Ring around him
Turned back by Caradhras; risks the Mines of Moria
Gandalf falls with the Balrog into the abyss
Rests in Lothlórien under Galadriel's protection
Fellowship breaks; sets out for Mordor with only Sam
Captures Gollum and binds him to serve as guide
Gollum lures him into Shelob's lair; the spider's venom fells him
Orcs carry him off; Sam sets out to rescue him
At Mount Doom he claims the Ring for himself
Gollum bites off his finger and falls into the Fire; Ring destroyed
Eagles rescue him and Sam from the ruin
Broken by the quest, sails from the Grey Havens
